soft_reject_units: send a POST request to soft-reject worker results for specified unit IDs with an optional review note
send_feedback_to_worker: send a review note as a feedback message to the worker assigned to a unit when soft-rejecting
get_assigned_agent: retrieve the assigned agent for a unit before soft-rejecting their work
update_unit_status: refresh the unit status in the database immediately after soft-rejecting to keep other endpoints in sync
validate_unit_ids: validate that unit_ids parameter is specified before attempting to soft-reject any units
